description:
Verify a signed print locally with ECDSA P-256/SHA-256. Canonical bytes are pulse-index-v1
<symbol>
<priceText or String(price)>
<at>
<grade>. The public key ring is read from /api/index/v1/pubkey, cached for five minutes and refreshed at most once per 30 seconds on a failed check. A supplied kid selects only that exact key; old prints without kid are tried against the bounded published ring. valid=true authenticates only the canonical price fields, not kid, sig, quality, cadence, timestamps outside at, or other metadata. When the print carries a v2 block (pulse-index-v2), it is verified too: v2.valid=true means the signature over v2.canonical is valid AND every signed line (sources, tier, confidence, dispersionBps, interval, cadence, engine, price and the rest) matches the supplied fields; v2.signedFields are the signed values and v2.mismatches names any field that differs. recordValid=true and verificationScope=full-record require BOTH price and complete v2 record verification. metadataSigned equals recordValid. Require recordValid before trusting quality fields. A v1-only print has scope price-only, never verified metadata. Neither signature proves freshness or settlement suitability; indicative data must not be used for settlement. An invalid signature can mean an altered print or a key no longer published; it does not by itself prove tampering.

assetId.description: Asset identifier from the print, unchanged, when provided

band.description: Update cadence band, from the print

calculatedAgeMs.description: Age of the calculation in milliseconds, from the print

newestSourceAgeMs.description: Age of the newest exchange quote in milliseconds, from the print

oldestSourceAgeMs.description: Age of the oldest exchange quote in milliseconds, from the print

p50UpdateMs.description: Median time between updates in milliseconds, from the print

p95UpdateMs.description: 95th percentile time between updates in milliseconds, from the print

cadence.description: Cadence block from the print, unchanged, when provided

closeDay.description: UTC day of a daily close (YYYY-MM-DD), from the print, when provided

confidence.description: Confidence score from the print, unchanged, when provided

dispersionBps.description: Spread between contributing exchanges in basis points, from the print, when provided

engine.description: Pricing engine label from the print, unchanged, when provided

grade.description: Quality grade from the print, unchanged, e.g. consensus

lower.description: Lower bound of the price interval, from the print

upper.description: Upper bound of the price interval, from the print

interval.description: Price interval from the print, unchanged, when provided

kid.description: Signing key identifier, when provided by the API

kind.description: Print kind from the print, when provided (daily-close for a daily close)

licence.description: Plan licence from the print, unchanged, when provided (a signed v2 line on prints requested with licence=1)

price.description: Price from the print, unchanged (text or number)

priceText.description: Exact signed price text, when provided by the API; preserve unchanged

sig.description: Signature version from the print (pulse-index-v1), when provided

sources.description: Number of exchanges that contributed, from the print, when provided

symbol.description: Crypto ticker symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

tier.description: Coverage tier from the print, unchanged, when provided

v2.description: The v2 block from the print, unchanged: it signs the whole record, quality fields included

canonical.description: The exact signed string from the print, unchanged

kid.description: v2 signing key identifier, from the print

sig.description: v2 signature version (pulse-index-v2), from the print

signature.description: v2 ECDSA P-256 signature in base64, from the print

name: verify_print

recordValid.description: Both signatures and every required v2 field verified. Does not prove freshness or settlement suitability.

requestId.description: Identifier for this MCP call; not a signed price field.

valid.description: Legacy price-only signature check. Use recordValid for quality metadata.

title: Verify a Signed Print
